item.title: Suspicious: Voter ID Bill Defeated In Senate By Vote Of 7 Million To 53
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Suspicions arose in Congress after a bill to require voter ID failed in the Senate by a vote of 7 million to 53.

item.title: ‘UNO: Even More Brutal Edition’ Comes With Card That SWATs Your Family Members And Has Them Arrested On False Charges
item.description: U.S. — Mattel has announced the release of "Uno: Even More Brutal Edition" which will include cards that SWAT family members and have them arrested on bogus federal charges.

item.title: Man Surprised To Find Out He Has A Podcast
item.description: DALLAS, TX — One local man's life took an unexpected turn this week, after he was surprised to learn that he had a podcast.

item.title: Toddler Review: The Slide Is A Stunning Thrill Ride Whose Delights Never Cease
item.description: On a lovely jaunt to the playground this morning, I encountered a most breathtaking and addictive creation known simply as a "slide".

item.title: Minecraft Introduces Peaceful Protesters And OH NO THEY'VE BURNED DOWN THE VILLAGE
item.description: REDMOND, WA — Peaceful social justice leaders have come to the world of Minecraft to educate gamers about peaceful resistance as a means to fight for equal rights among the marginalized and OH NO! THEY BURNED DOWN THE VILLAGE!

item.title: American Society Of Plastic Surgeons Recommends No Longer Doing Those Surgeries That No One Was Doing
item.description: U.S. — The American Society of Plastic Surgeons has officially recommended that surgeons stop doing those gender surgeries on minors that absolutely no one was doing.

item.title: 'The Injuns Are A-Comin!' Cries Billie Eilish Loading Musket To Defend Home From Tribe Of Redskins
item.description: LOS ANGELES, CA — According to sources, American singer-songwriter Billie Eilish successfully defended her land from members of the Tongva Tribe, an indigenous people native to the LA basin, who claim her home is built on their land.

item.title: 10 Ways To Come Out As A Conservative To Your Liberal Parents
item.description: Our current society can have trouble showing acceptance — especially to conservatives. If you're a young conservative who has kept your political views a secret from your family, knowing how to tell your parents can be difficult.
